lines.text: The prophet's heart is broken and his bones tremble because of the LORD's holy words, and the land mourns.
The LORD found prophet and priest wicked even in His house, and they will be driven away into Egypt.
The LORD will feed the prophets wormwood and poisoned water, and tells the people not to listen to them.
The LORD did not send these prophets, and had they stood in His council, they would have turned people from evil.
